svg.title: Batch calculation preserves the A and B rows
svg.desc: Rows A=[2,1] and B=[1,1] use the same hidden weights and bias [0,2]. Hidden outputs are [4,1] and [3,2]. Output weights [2,-1] and bias 1 give predictions 8 and 5.

g.data-text: Batch calculation preserves the A and B rows
g.aria-label: Batch calculation preserves the A and B rows

g.data-text: Every sample uses the same weights and biases.
g.aria-label: Every sample uses the same weights and biases.

g.data-text: Add the same bias [0, 2] to each row.
g.aria-label: Add the same bias [0, 2] to each row.

g.data-text: All four entries of Z are positive, so H keeps them.
g.aria-label: All four entries of Z are positive, so H keeps them.

g.data-text: Actual targets: A = 6 min, B = 4 min
g.aria-label: Actual targets: A = 6 min, B = 4 min

g.data-text: N is the sample count. More samples do not add weights.
